dorsal_planar_contour_and_symmetry.axial_tapering: Smooth, symmetrical 2D geometric narrowing from the widest mid-body section toward the posterior peduncle.

surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.global_grayscale_baseline: Mature white; uniform high-intensity reflectance across the visible dorsal area.

high_frequency_epidermal_anomalies.localized_point_contrast_disruptions: Faint, longitudinal linear markings visible on the mid-dorsal plane, likely representing superficial rake marks.
high_frequency_epidermal_anomalies.dorsal_surface_indentations: Pronounced circular indentation at the anterior blowhole; sharp longitudinal ridge along the posterior dorsal axis creating a distinct highlight-to-shadow transition.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Multiple faint, healed longitudinal rake marks present on the central dorsal surface.
other_distinctive_markers: Visible transverse epidermal creases/folds located in the cervical region posterior to the head.
